title: Survival Phrases
description: Essential courteous phrases, daily greetings, and navigating Tokyo campus environments.
reviewedBy: Kazi Sakib (Founding Mentor, University of Tokyo)

items.prompt: おはようございます (Ohayou gozaimasu)
items.explanation: Polite morning greeting used with professors, colleagues, and seniors.
The most versatile polite phrase in Japan: 'Excuse me', 'I am sorry', and 'Thank you for your trouble'.

items.prompt: ありがとうございます (Arigatou gozaimasu)
items.soundText: ありがとうございます
items.explanation: Standard polite expression of sincere gratitude.

items.prompt: 英語を話せますか (Eigo o hanasemasu ka)
items.explanation: Polite question asking if the listener can speak English.

items.prompt: 駅はどこですか (Eki wa doko desu ka)
items.explanation: 'eki' = train station, 'doko' = where, 'desu ka' = question particle.
options: How much is the train ticket?
What time does the train leave?

items.prompt: これはいくらですか (Kore wa ikura desu ka)
items.explanation: 'kore' = this, 'ikura' = how much. Essential for stores and restaurants.
options: Can I have two of these?

items.explanation: Polite negative form of 'wakaru' (to understand): 'I don't understand / I don't know'.
options: I don't understand / I don't know
items.correctAnswer: I don't understand / I don't know

items.explanation: Polite request phrase ('Please' / 'I leave it in your care').
options: Please / If you would be so kind
items.correctAnswer: Please / If you would be so kind
